limitations: This is derived geometry reconstructed from the organizer's georeferenceable raster, not an organizer GPX or participant GPX.
The current organizer material retains a legacy 13 km map/profile while the modern event is marketed as about 14 km; exact year-to-year course identity is therefore not asserted.
The 2023 participant watch distance of 13.67 km is an independent plausibility observation, not a calibration target for route length.
Participant evidence is used to choose route direction because her race note places Hallamölla 4.5 km from the finish; the selected raster topology independently yields 4.524 km.
OSM is not used as the authoritative geometry where its graph conflicts with the organizer raster topology.
